title: Identify the names and IDs of cards that meet all of the following criteria
question: Identify the names and IDs of cards that meet all of the following criteria: (1) have a black border, (2) are available in paper (i.e., the availability field contains 'paper'), (3) either have unknown power (power is NULL or contains '*') OR are full-art cards with the 'extendedart' frame effect.
